metadata.author: grokbot-2 (art)
metadata.for: 0007 RegionCameraData stops[id=meadow].pose (AuthoredPose: position + target + fovVerticalDeg; rotation derived by fromLookAt(up=+Y), roll 0)
metadata.coordinates: Cocos world, +Y up, metres, meadow scene local: meadow_greybox_v0_8.glb root (scene_root) at the origin with identity transform. If the meadow region root is placed elsewhere in the region world, transform position and target by that root.
metadata.projection: perspective, fovAxis vertical, near 0.05, far 1000 (0007 fixed params), aspect follows the screen
metadata.target_note: target = optical-axis hit on the terrain (screen centre), raycast in Blender on meadow_terrain

ndc_projection_check.note: NDC x right, y up, [-1,1]; computed in Blender with the exact pose; 0.46 = 540x1174, 0.75 = 600x800. UI reserve = bottom 25% = NDC y < -0.5. Bounding boxes only: not an occlusion or HUD test.

metadata.framing: Windmill + sail sweep in the upper third (left of centre), wind-bell frame / region_interaction_point right of the door, tree on the right, path winds from player_spawn (just above the UI band) to the windmill door. Bottom 25% is plain grass for the board/UI buttons. Level horizon (roll 0), looking roughly north: yaw ~7.6 deg, pitch ~-18.0 deg, 66.4 m to target, 24.8 m above the terrain.
